headline: New Zealand Cyber Incidents Drive Financial Losses Up to $5.9 Million
summary: A sharp rise in reported cyber security incidents across New Zealand pushed direct national financial losses up to $5.9 million.
why: National cyber security centers track digital fraud and corporate infrastructure security threats.
